name: verdict-monorepo
description: VERDICT — REA for DFIR: unified local-first DFIR MCP, CLI, CaseForge privacy/model controller, Rust forensic toolkit, and cryptographic custody spine.
author: Timothy Vang

scripts.build: npm run build -w @verdict/caseforge-sdk && npm run build -w @verdict/mcp && npm run build -w @verdict/report && npm run build -w @verdict/cli && npm run build -w @verdict/caseforge-tui && npm run build -w @verdict/caseforge-cli
scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @verdict/caseforge-sdk && npm run build -w @verdict/mcp && npm run build -w @verdict/report && npm run build -w @verdict/cli
scripts.test: npm run test:mcp && npm run test:report && npm run test:cli && npm run attack:custody
